verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official MCP server that coding agents can connect to. Through it, agents can read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage scan issues (cubic-docs-8, cubic-probe-4). Setup is documented for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and Gemini CLI (cubic-docs-35), and the changelog shows the server expanding into subscription and seat management (cubic-docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
